generation.explanation: The inscribed angle theorem says that for a fixed chord AB, every point P on the same arc sees AB at the same angle, which is half the central angle AOB. Drag the yellow point P along the circle's major arc and the angle at P stays constant. The label shows it is always half of the central angle.
